name: group-16-pharmacy-pos
description: Multi-tenant pharmacy point-of-sale and dispensing platform. Deployed as a single service: the server serves the built client from its own origin.

scripts.install:server: npm --prefix server ci || npm --prefix server install
scripts.install:client: npm --prefix client ci || npm --prefix client install
scripts.install:all: npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix client run build
